description: This Java class defines a custom scale transition for Android UI animations, used to animate views scaling in and out during activity transitions, particularly for a floating action button in a tourist attractions app.

classes.name: ScaleTransition
classes.description: A custom transition class extending Visibility to animate scaling of views during appearance and disappearance, used for transitions in the Android UI.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator that scales a view from startScale to endScale on both X and Y axes.

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Overrides the Visibility method to animate the view scaling in from 0 to 1.

methods.name: onDisappear
methods.description: Overrides the Visibility method to animate the view scaling out from 1 to 0.
